When evaluating a season pass or similar live-ops system, ask players about three linked concerns: reward clarity, effort-to-value balance, and whether the progression path feels respectful of time.

Good questionnaire prompts avoid vague satisfaction wording alone. Pair an overall rating with one or two diagnostic questions that reveal whether frustration comes from pacing, reward variety, or confusion about milestones.

If researchers expect differences between payer and non-payer cohorts, include a segment field in metadata and preserve that context in downstream interpretation.
